good_thing: (Pittsboro, North Carolina): Rescue crews found Preston Scott Hill on rocks along a difficult stretch of the Haw River after he was reported missing. Multiple local and state agencies lifted the 35-year-old Raleigh resident out by helicopter and took him to UNC Hospitals; his mother said he was expected to be okay.
current_or_history: On September 11, 1893, Swami Vivekananda spoke at the opening of the World’s Parliament of Religions at what is now the Art Institute of Chicago. He began with the welcoming words, “Sisters and Brothers of America.”
tiny_fact: Bare-nosed wombats make cube-shaped feces. A peer-reviewed study found the cubes form in the final 17% of the intestine, where differing wall stiffness helps contractions make corners as the material firms up.
thought: You do not have to solve the whole week today; one steady next step is plenty.
